description: Java class defining the CalculatedField data model with properties, constructors, and methods, used within the Thingsboard platform for managing calculated fields.

classes.name: CalculatedField
classes.description: Data model class for a calculated field, including properties like tenantId, entityId, type, name, debug settings, configuration, version, and additional info, with constructors and overridden methods.

methods.name: CalculatedField(CalculatedFieldId id)
methods.description: Constructor initializing CalculatedField with an ID.

methods.name: CalculatedField(CalculatedField calculatedField)
methods.description: Copy constructor for deep copying an existing CalculatedField.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the CalculatedFieldId of this object.

methods.name: getCreatedTime()
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the calculated field.

methods.name: isDebugMode()
methods.description: Returns the debug mode status (ignored for serialization).

methods.name: setDebugMode(boolean debugMode)
methods.description: Sets the debug mode status (used during deserialization).

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CalculatedField object.
